charts.label: US Number 1s
charts.title: US Number 1s
charts.about: Every #1 of the US Hot 100 (US Billboard Hot 100) in this decade, in the order they got there.

charts.label: UK Number 1s
charts.title: UK Number 1s
charts.about: Every #1 of the UK Top 100 (UK Official Singles Chart Top 100) in this decade, in the order they got there.

charts.label: Christmas classics
charts.title: Christmas classics
charts.about: Songs that come back to the charts every Christmas: in at least 3 different Christmas seasons in the NL, UK or US charts, and mostly then. Most seasons first.

charts.label: Longest comebacks
charts.title: Longest comebacks
charts.about: Songs that came back to the NL, UK or US charts after the longest time away, at least 5 years. Longest gap first.

charts.label: Songs that named children
charts.title: Songs that named children
charts.about: US top 40 hits titled with a first name, after which that name grew faster in US births than before (1950–2008). Strongest growth first.

charts.label: Love at #1
charts.title: Love at #1
charts.about: Every #1 of the NL, UK and US charts with love in the title (love, lover, lovin', liefde…), in the order they got there.

charts.label: Long runners
charts.title: Long runners
charts.about: The songs with the most weeks in the NL, UK or US chart. Most weeks first.
